statements.status_notes: CPython issue 155292 currently links fixes for main and 3.15 plus an open 3.14 backport, but no 3.10-3.13 maintenance-branch backports. Those branches still contain the affected stringprep implementation, so branch-specific backports remain under investigation. See https://github.com/python/cpython/issues/155292

This DHI package backports CPython's bounded decompression fix for BZIP2 and LZMA ZIP members, plus Zstandard where available, preventing attacker-controlled unbounded decompression output. See https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-15310 and https://github.com/python/cpython/pull/156003

This DHI package backports CPython's tarfile extraction-filter fix, preventing crafted member names from leaving and returning to the extraction destination. See https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-19672 and https://github.com/python/cpython/pull/156000

This DHI package backports CPython's URL-scheme-aware HTTPPasswordMgr credential matching fix, preventing HTTPS credentials from matching HTTP requests. See https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-15806 and https://github.com/python/cpython/pull/155696

base64 decoding stops after the first padded quad by default. The fix is available in Python 3.13.13 and newer maintained branches; DHI backport assessment for older packaged streams is pending.
False positive. CVE-2026-12003 affects CPython 3.11 and newer; Python 3.10.20 is not in the upstream affected branch set for gh-151544.

Hash-flooding vulnerability in xml.parsers.expat and xml.etree.ElementTree due to insufficient entropy. Requires both libexpat 2.8.0+ and CPython changes; waiting for coordinated fixed Python packages.
SimpleCookie.js_output() base64 hardening is pending a DHI backport for Python 3.10-3.12; upstream is https://github.com/python/cpython/pull/148848.
asyncio.AbstractEventLoop.sock_recvfrom_into() is not present in Python 3.10; the CVE targets the 3.11+ API (see CPython 3.11+).
Waiting for upstream fix; fix only available in 3.13.10+ and not backported to 3.10/3.11/3.12
